_meta.title: Vaccine Injury Accountability — Canada
_meta.scope: mRNA COVID-19 vaccine injury documentation, Hartman v. Canada (AG), VISP program failures, CAEFISS confirmed safety signals, StatCan excess mortality
_meta.note: All figures drawn from Canadian government primary sources (PHAC, StatCan, Ontario courts) or Global News investigative reporting citing named claimants.

hartman_case.trial_outcome: Claim dismissed with no leave to amend
hartman_case.trial_holding: There is no private law duty of care to individual members of the public injured by government core policy decisions in the handling of health emergencies which impact the general population.
legal_framework: Anns/Cooper test for duty of care

pathology.findings_reported: Tissue samples examined; findings supporting vaccine-related cause of death submitted by plaintiff

appeal_issues: Whether the trial judge erred in applying the Anns/Cooper test
Whether the trial judge properly distinguished between policy and operational acts
Whether the trial judge erred in striking the claim for misfeasance in public office
hartman_case.implication: If the appeal fails, Canadian law holds that individuals injured by mass government health policy have no private law claim against the government, leaving the Vaccine Injury Support Program as the only recourse — a program that has approved only 234 of 3,317 claims (7%).

caefiss_confirmed_signals.source: Public Health Agency of Canada — Canadian Adverse Events Following Immunization Surveillance System (CAEFISS)

confirmed_signals.mechanism: Blood clots with low platelet count
Inflammation of heart muscle / lining around the heart
confirmed_signals.age_finding: Rate in individuals under 40 years old is HIGHER than expected in this age group in the general population
confirmed_signals.note: PHAC statement: 'data in Canada now indicating a higher number of cases in younger people (less than 40 years of age) than would normally be expected in this age group in the general population.'

statcan_excess_mortality.source: Statistics Canada — Provisional death counts and excess mortality

periods.note: Driven primarily by Quebec and Ontario

critical_age_finding.interpretation: StatCan's own data shows Canadians under 65 accounted for 30% of excess mortality but only 10% of COVID deaths. The Canadian government's own statistics indicate that factors OTHER than COVID are driving excess mortality among younger Canadians. This disparity post-dates the mass mRNA vaccination rollout in 2021.

program_administration_findings.administrator: Oxaro Inc. (formerly Raymond Chabot Grant Thornton Consulting)
program_administration_findings.admin_to_payout_ratio_note: For every $1 paid to injured Canadians, $1.99 was spent on administration.

expert_criticism.expert: Dr. Kumanan Wilson (Ottawa Hospital Research Institute)
expert_criticism.quote: You don't want to stand these things up right in the middle of an emergency.

internal_operations_findings: Described by former employees as 'chaos' with multiple 'bottlenecks'
High staff turnover — one claimant had 9 different case managers
Unidentified physicians reject claims without consulting applicants
Case managers unreachable for months or years
Processing delays of 12-18+ months are standard

the_accountability_loop.thesis: Canada has constructed a CLOSED LOOP that prevents accountability for vaccine-related injuries and deaths.
the_accountability_loop.step_1_onca_hartman: Trial court (March 2025) held that Canadians injured by government health-emergency policy have NO private law duty of care claim. If ONCA upholds, courts are closed to negligence and misfeasance claims against government for mass vaccination policy.
the_accountability_loop.step_2_visp_denial: The only alternative path — the Vaccine Injury Support Program — has approved 7% of claims (234 of 3,317) and spends twice as much on administration as on payments to injured Canadians.
the_accountability_loop.step_3_regulatory_capture: Health Canada approved the mRNA products under interim order (s. 30.1 Food and Drugs Act) without long-term safety data. The same regulator is responsible for vaccine safety monitoring.
the_accountability_loop.step_4_data_suppression: StatCan's age-stratified excess mortality data shows 30% of excess deaths in <65yo vs. 10% of COVID deaths in that age group — but no federal investigation has been launched into non-COVID excess mortality.
the_accountability_loop.conclusion: When the courts, the compensation program, the regulator, and the statistical agency all operate within the same accountability framework as the entities whose actions they are meant to check, accountability becomes structurally impossible. That is the situation Canadians face as of April 2026.

hartman_timeline_expanded.description: Sean Hartman died aged 17, approximately 6 weeks post-vaccination. Cause of death cited in family filings as vaccine-induced myocarditis.
Justice Antoniani (Ontario Superior Court) held that the Crown owes no private-law duty of care to individual members of the public injured by government core-policy decisions in health emergencies.
